nodes.label: Money Formatting Macro (data-v attribute)
nodes.rationale: The exact numeric value is stored in the data-v attribute; JS decides at render time whether to show it abbreviated or exact, so toggling the format never requires a page reload.

nodes.label: Sticky KPI Strip
nodes.rationale: A fixed strip of headline numbers answers 'how is the business doing' regardless of which tab the user has open; kept sticky (position:sticky) so it survives scrolling.

nodes.label: Tabbed Sections (Resumen/Comercial/Clientes/Operación/Servicios)
nodes.rationale: Content is split into tabs so the user answers one question at a time instead of everything competing for attention on one screen; charts are lazily instantiated only when their tab is first shown because Chart.js measures 0x0 (and renders blank) inside a display:none container.

nodes.label: Revenue Chart with Selectable Granularity (day/week/month/quarter/year)
nodes.rationale: Daily series is the fine grain, re-bucketed client-side; default granularity is 'week' because a single month at daily resolution is one uninformative point. Dates are parsed by parts (not `new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')`) to avoid a UTC/Bogotá off-by-one-day bug. Empty buckets are still emitted (as zero) rather than skipped so a day with no sales isn't rendered as a gap.

nodes.label: Detail Drill-down Modal (click chart bar/point)
nodes.rationale: Chart click detection uses mode 'index' without intersect so clicking anywhere in a column opens the detail, since short/thin bars make pixel-perfect clicks unreliable.

nodes.label: Grouped Service Checklist with Collapsible Categories
nodes.rationale: A category group auto-expands only if it already has a checked service, since a collapsed group would hide the existing selection; a badge count is the only signal of what's selected inside a collapsed group.
nodes.norm_label: grouped service checklist with collapsible categories

nodes.label: Multiple Discount/Surcharge Rows
nodes.rationale: A percentage can be computed over list price or over the subtotal already including the agreement; none chains onto the previous adjustment, so row order never changes the final total.

nodes.label: Multiple Partial Payments (Abonos) Rows
nodes.rationale: A partial payment does not lower the service's value, only the balance still owed.

nodes.label: Real-time Price Preview Box
nodes.rationale: Balance-due row only appears when there are payments; without payments, balance equals total and repeating the figure would just be noise.

nodes.label: Per-column Filter Row (text/select/date-range)
nodes.rationale: Filter inputs bind to their column via an explicit data-col attribute instead of the <th> position, because DataTables removes the hidden Timestamp column's header from the DOM, which used to shift every filter input onto the wrong column. Search terms are also accent-stripped so users don't have to type Spanish tildes.

nodes.label: Notification Bell Dropdown (polling)
nodes.rationale: Polls /api/notifications every 30s and also refreshes immediately on tab visibilitychange so badge counts don't go stale while the tab was backgrounded. A notification without a url is informative-only: clicking marks it read but does not navigate.

nodes.label: Role-conditional Menu Visibility (admin/operario/marketing)
nodes.rationale: The logo link and menu items branch by current_user.role because a marketing user has no appointments agenda to return to, and showing links the server would reject anyway is just noise.

nodes.label: Adaptive Event Box Line Truncation
nodes.rationale: A ResizeObserver re-measures each event box because at mount time FullCalendar hasn't given it its final height yet. Lines are hidden (not removed) bottom-up as space runs out, with the client's name protected as the last line to drop; notes get a variable line-clamp tried from most to fewest lines to use whatever space remains.

nodes.label: Admin Keyword Delete Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Deleting an appointment is permanent, so the client prompts for an admin keyword before submitting; this client-side prompt is described as 'the gate, not the lock' — real validation happens server-side.

nodes.label: Event Click → Fetch Appointment JSON → Populate Modal
nodes.norm_label: event click → fetch appointment json → populate modal

nodes.label: Activate/Deactivate/Delete Category Controls
nodes.rationale: Categories that already have expenses attached cannot be deleted, only deactivated, so they stop appearing on new-expense forms without breaking historical records.

nodes.label: Managerial Dashboard (Tablero Gerencial)
nodes.rationale: Designed to be read in 30 seconds and answer 'are we doing well?'; every figure is compared to the immediately preceding period of equal length because a number alone says nothing — the direction of change does.

nodes.label: Period-over-period Delta Indicator (▲/▼ %)
nodes.rationale: delta() macro takes a 'mejor' (better-is-higher vs. better-is-lower) parameter so metrics like cancellation rate, where a drop is good, still color correctly as an improvement.

nodes.label: Conditional Business Alerts (losses, cold leads, high cancellation)
nodes.rationale: Alerts that demand a decision are placed above every other section so they can't be missed by scrolling past them.
